subject: Vendor registration + PO windowing for multi-entity billing
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@paygreen.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@paygreen.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 09:01:00 +0000
Subject: Vendor registration + PO handling questions

Hi Vanessa,

We're starting Redwood's vendor onboarding in PayGreen's supplier portal and have a few questions to make sure invoices and POs reconcile cleanly across our EU and UK entities. Can you confirm the following so we can finish your profile and route POs correctly?

1) Legal entity names + VAT IDs for each billing entity (UK vs EU). We need exact text that should appear on the invoice header.
2) Preferred remit-to bank account details (IBAN/BIC for EU; sort code/acc for UK) and any required beneficiary reference.
3) Do you prefer: (A) one supplier record with multiple remit accounts and PO split-lines, or (B) separate supplier IDs per legal entity? PayGreen's portal supports both, but our payment engine treats them differently for automated PO-to-invoice matching.
4) Invoice URN/numbering scheme you will use (we require vendor-provided invoice reference + our PO number in header).
5) Any line-level VAT breakdown requirements (reverse-charge flags, zero-rated line codes, or VAT split per line).

I've attached our vendor registration CSV to speed this up. Our goal is to have Redwood live in the portal and able to receive POs by the first of next month. If you can send the details and a sample invoice (PDF) we will validate mapping and enable auto-ack.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Senior AP Manager, PayGreen

Attachment: PayGreen_vendor_register_template.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@paygreen.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO handling questions

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear checklist. Looping in Marcus (Payments) and Rachel (Billing Ops) to confirm technical details and provide the files you need. See answers below and action items.

Quick answers:
- We prefer option (A): single supplier record with two remit accounts (simpler for our AP ops), but we can do (B) if PayGreen needs separate supplier IDs for legal/regulatory reasons.
- Invoice URN: REDW-{COUNTRY}-{YYYY}-{SEQ} e.g. REDW-UK-2026-000123. We'll include your PO number in the invoice header and also populate the PO in the "external_ref" field in the invoice metadata.

Action items:
1) Marcus: bank stub and remit details (attached). Please confirm IBAN/BIC and beneficiary reference.
2) Rachel: sample invoice PDF showing per-line VAT split and the URN format. We'll provide a copy back to you in a moment.
3) Liam: can you confirm whether PayGreen's portal accepts a single supplier with multiple remit accounts and line-level VAT flags enabled? If not, we'll provide separate supplier IDs.

Proposed timeline: we can fill and return your CSV today and request portal activation tomorrow. If that works, aiming for PO flow to start 2026-09-01.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_bank_remit_stub.pdf (PDF, 8KB)

Thanks — that's very helpful. PayGreen confirms we can support a single supplier with multiple remit accounts and line-level tax flags. A couple of follow-ups before we activate the supplier record:

• Please complete the attached CSV and return it (I'll validate mapping after submission).
• For automated PO matching: make sure the invoice header includes both your URN and our PO number in the top section (we'll prefer the PO in the "PO Number" field but fall back to header text).
• For VAT: we'll set reverse-charge flags on lines where you indicate "reverse_charge": true. We will need you to populate the line-level tax code column in the CSV.

If you can return the completed CSV and a signed vendor self-cert (EU VAT) by end of day tomorrow we will move you through the automated onboarding flow and push a test PO.

I appreciate the fast turnaround — looking forward to running the test PO.

Best,
Liam
